question: Can antiSMASH's KnownClusterBlast measure distance to known phosphonate clusters?
note: region_tabulation.tsv carries EMPTY KCB_hit/KCB_acc/KCB_sim columns for all 334 regions in this run and in the pre-recovery run, although antiSMASH did write knownclusterblast output — so the report's KCB fields are blank. Flagged, not investigated.
conclusion: Distance to characterised clusters is measured with BiG-SCAPE instead; see ../bigscape_references.
